expectations.text: Asks exactly one grilling question; a single procedural file-layout question is allowed because no docs exist yet, but no other grilling questions are bundled in
expectations.evidence: Four numbered questions plus inline ones.

expectations.text: The grilling question uses the Q:/Recommendation format with a concrete recommendation (not 'it depends')
Uses plain business language with NO DDD jargon (bounded context, ubiquitous language, subdomain, anti-corruption layer, ACL, core domain) anywhere in the user-facing text
Because no CONTEXT files exist, it proposes or asks about a documentation file structure before capturing decisions
expectations.evidence: Proposes a relational schema, not a docs/context-file structure.

expectations.text: Keeps implementation details (DB schemas, table layouts, tech-stack choices) out of the response — stays at the level of what the product is and what makes it unique
expectations.evidence: Leaks implementation: Postgres, restaurant_id, full relational shape.
